python.title: Inventory in Python
python.brief: Implement the same stock contract as exercise 1. Input: initial stock, request count, then one amount per line. Print OK or Refused for each request, then the stock. Store the stock on an Inventory instance.
python.starter:
class Inventory:
    # __init__, take and available
    pass

stock = int(input())
n = int(input())
# process n requests
python.solution:
class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, stock): self._stock = stock
    def take(self, amount):
        if amount <= 0 or amount > self._stock: return False
        self._stock -= amount
        return True
    def available(self): return self._stock

item = Inventory(int(input()))
n = int(input())
for _ in range(n):
    print("OK" if item.take(int(input())) else "Refused")
print(item.available())

python.solution:
class Shape:
    def area(self): raise NotImplementedError
class Square(Shape):
    def __init__(self,s): self.s=s
    def area(self): return self.s*self.s
class Rectangle(Shape):
    def __init__(self,w,h): self.w,self.h=w,h
    def area(self): return self.w*self.h

parts=input().split()
shape=Square(int(parts[1])) if parts[0]=="S" else Rectangle(int(parts[1]),int(parts[2]))
print(shape.area())
